title: Kernel
description: The all-in-one server plugin | Optimized - Easy-To-Use - Multiple Features
body:
## What is Kernel? ⚡

Kernel is more than just another plugin, it’s designed to be the **only plugin you’ll ever need** to cover all the **essential** server features. My goal is to combine everything you typically need into one optimized, **easy-to-use** plugin, so managing your server becomes smoother and simpler.

With **Kernel**, you’ll have access to a wide range of features, including but not limited to:

✨ Chat Management: Clearchat, Mutechat, Chatfilter, Broadcast, Staff Chat
🛠️ Player Management: Ban, Kick, Warn, Mute, Invsee
⚙️ Server Optimization: Clearlag
🎉 Extras: Event hosting, Auto messages, Verification systems, and much more!

*please note: I’m building Kernel as a single-developer project, so updates and releases might take a little time. Thanks for your patience! 🙏*

If you have any feature ideas or suggestions, I’d love to hear them in <#1449726935231103066>. Your feedback will help make Kernel even better, and I'm not just saying that, I **will** respond to every single suggestion and consider them.


## Will Kernel be paid? 💰

Kernel will be **completely free** at launch, giving everyone access to all features from day one.  My goal is to make it accessible for everyone while maintaining quality and updates.


## How Can You Help? 🤝

Even though Kernel is currently a **single-developer** project, there are a few ways you can **support** it and help it grow:

**Suggestions**: Share feature ideas or improvements in <#1449726935231103066>. Every suggestion is read and considered.

**Report Bugs**: You can report bug or problems by opening a ticket in <#1449726935700734029> and selecting **Report a Bug**.

**Contribution Tickets**: If you’re a developer, you can help by opening contribution tickets in <#1449726935700734029>  with improvements or bug fixes.

**Donations**: If you’d like to support the project financially, you can do so through the provided donation link. Every bit helps keep Kernel updated and maintained!

Donation Link:

Your support, feedback, and contributions will make Kernel better for everyone! 🏆
